messages:
alex: kicked off canary v4-int4 @2% for /v1/answer. initial smoke: longdoc slice (>=1800 tokens) MRR down ~0.028 abs vs v4-fp16.
deploy-bot: canary canary-5209998888 -> 2% us-central1.
maria: latency unchanged; kv-cache hit-rate down ~1.5% on longdocs.
tom: our auto-rollback rule is abs_mrr_drop>0.015 over 10m; should have fired. maybe metric smoothing.
alex: options: rollback, route-pin longdocs to fp16, or restrict int4 to seq<1800.
tom: applying conditional pin: `infractl route update --route=/v1/answer --condition="seq>=1800" --model=v4-fp16`.
deploy-bot: route update applied.
maria: spinning focused eval with kv_warmup and seed=99 to reproduce. jobctl run_eval --model=v4-int4 --slice=longdoc --kv_warmup=true --seed=99
alex: opened INC-5209999000 and tagged eng-ml triage. will attach diffs, reranker scores, and kv traces.
tom: policy proposal: composite gate requiring mrr_longdoc AND hallucination_delta<0.01; raise longdoc rollback threshold to 0.02.
maria: will draft policy patch and run 6h shadow rerank.
alex: monitoring dashboard; will update thread with eval results. :thumbsup:
